raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. transparent, colourless, natural mineral, hablur; ( as ornament ) kristal: a ~ necklace, rantai kristal; 2. glass of high quality, kristal: ~ bowl, mangkuk kristal; 3. regular shape formed by substance when it solidifies, hablur: copper sulphate ~s, hablur kuprum sulfat; 4. glass covering face of watch, clock, cermin (jam). (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : adj ( liter. ) transparent, jernih: the ~ waters of the lake, air tasik yg jernih; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
